Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1329
Claimant:
Denise Jacobs
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
6-2-24
The driver, who is named on the policy, reported a low-speed head-on collision in a parking area and a neck and back
injury to the claimant. Coverage was active at the time, and nothing suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy
start.
6-5-24
The attending officer recorded the claimant as present in the vehicle at the scene, but the file holds no separate
report of the collision itself. No witnesses or photos have been identified so far.
6-8-24
The vehicle inspection shows dents to the front bumper cover and hood, positioned lower and toward the passenger
side than the impact the driver described. The location and height do not line up with the account given.
6-11-24
The claimant describes the impact as a light bump but reports severe neck and back pain. The severity of the claimed
injury is hard to square with a contact that seems this minor.
6-27-24
Prior medical history was checked, and there is no record of earlier injury to the neck or back. Nothing in the records
points to a preexisting condition in that area.
7-30-24
On the follow-up call, the claimant repeated the same account of the collision, in the same order and with the same
details as the first statement. No new facts came up.
7-31-24
Treatment began with an initial clinic visit, then moved to physiotherapy and medication. Visits gradually tapered as
the claimant reported improvement, which is a usual course for a strain of this kind.
9-26-24
Records of prior claims and the vehicle's service history were reviewed, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is
known.
11-6-24
Policy inception and endorsement dates were confirmed. Nothing suggests the damage occurred before coverage
started.
11-21-24
The claimant has not been reprseented by counsel and has been asked for phtoos of the scene and any witness
contact details. None have been provided at this stage.
12-29-24
The file was reviewed against the inspection findings and the treatment timeline. The gap between the reported
impact and the damage pattern remains open for discussion with the handling team.
12-31-24
Calim remains open pending further review of the damage evaluation and the treatment records. The next step is to
confirm the impact location with the repair shop before any decision is made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
